en.name: Arraiolos rug
description:
Despite carpet production beginning in Portugal in the 14th century, carpet production centred in the town of Arraiolos had later origins, with its first references dating to the end of the 16th century, and first known examples dating from the beginning of the 17th century. Created in a domestic setting, these carpets have the particularity of being entirely wool-embroidered through a thread-counting process. This was done on a linen or hemp canvas. Its characteristic stitch is that of Arraiolos, a cross-stitch known as Greek stitch or as Slavic cross-stitch (also known as *ponto de Arraiolos*). This said, the earliest examples also present motifs outlined in “stem-stitch”, as in this case.  
This rug represents the “flower pattern” decoration sub-category of carpets, which is thought to date back to the 17th century and is characterised by vegetal inspired ornaments. In opposition to a field balanced and organised in accordance to a central longitudinal axis of symmetry, a border formed by eight well-designed, alternated, elongated lobes and winding vegetal motifs is continuously embroidered in such a manner that it does not respect the edges of the rug. The recourse to flower-like lobed medallions, alternated with quatrefoils, filling up the field, as well as the colour scheme and the tri-dimensional effect suggested by the layout, lead this type of carpet to be called “tile-pattern” carpets. This is due to their similarity to the patterned tile (*azulejos*) panels produced in Portugal during the same period.
holder: Museum of Portuguese Decorative Arts – Ricardo do Espírito Santo Silva Foundation
keywords: Portuguese carpet; embroidery; Arraiolos stitch; *ponto de Arraiolos*; 17th century

en.name: Portrait of Cardinal Sembratowicz
description:
Sylwester Sembratowicz (1836–98) had been metropolitan Archbishop of Lviv (in Polish Lwów or Lvov), of the Greek-Catholic denomination, since 1885. In 1895, he became Cardinal. He was also a professor and Dean of the Theological Faculty at the Jan Kazimierz University in Lviv.  
Cardinal Sembratowicz is depicted sitting on a highly decorated armchair in the sacral interior, behind him is a lectern covered with embroidered drapery. Beneath his feet, we see a precious carpet, probably a Persian carpet of the Tabriz type. On the carpet’s softly painted surface it is possible to recognise an ornament of elaborately woven palmettes, with many colourful details that are joined with wavy tendrils, on a red ground. The border is dark-blue, filled with a row of palmettes. Persian carpets were very popular among wealthy inhabitants of Lviv in the 19th and 20th centuries. A very similar carpet, dating to the 19th century, is preserved in the collections of the National Museum in Kraków (inv. no. MNK XIX-12064). In spite of this carpet’s generous dimensions, the Janelli family took it with them into exile when forced to leave Lviv by the Soviet authorities in 1946.
keywords: Sylwester Sembratowicz; Aleksander Augustynowicz; Lviv (Lwów or Lvov); Tabriz; carpets in art

en.name: Plate
description: This is one of a set of twenty-four plates commissioned by the antiquarian Horace Walpole (1717-1797) from the Miotti family glasshouse in Venice during a visit in 1741. Each plate is made from glass whitened with an arsenic compound which makes it opaque, and is decorated with a different view of Venice. These were likely never intended for use by Walpole, and by 1774 were on display in his China Room at his villa Strawberry Hill, west London. Amongst Walpole's vast collection of ceramics - particularly English and European porcelain - these plates would have imitated this luxury material with their white colouring.

en.name: Lotus tile
description: Two lotus blossoms painted in white and black on a cobalt blue ground. A half-blossom can be seen in the bottom right corner, while a complete blossom is shown on a stem to the left. On the back of the tile, the Arabic letters *lr lr* incised in the paste. Tiles with a similar restricted palette and a similar treatment of the stylised lotus blossoms were used for the redecoration of the Dome of the Rock in Jerusalem, during the extensive restoration ordered by Süleyman the Magnificent. Therefore, the tile could have been made in an Ottoman workshop from Syria dating back to the mid-sixteenth century.

de.name: Prunkstreitkolben, sog. *Buzogan*
description: Dieser Prunkstreitkolben wurde in einer besonders in Ägypten, Persien und Indien geübten, Intarsientechnik mit Stern- und Blütenmustern überzogen. Diese Muster wurde aus Stäbchen von Elfenbein, braunem und schwarzem Edelholz sowie Messingstiften gebildet. Der Stiel wird durch ein Elfenbeinende abgeschlossen. Prunkstreitkolben waren seit der Antike das hervorstechende Würdezeichen vornehmer Orientalen.

en.name: Mace, so-called *buzogan*
description: This ceremonial mace was embellished with star and flower inlays, a technique popular in Egypt, Persia and India. The decoration consists of tiny pieces of ivory, brown and black wood, and brass sticks. A piece of ivory forms the end of the handle. Since antiquity, ceremonial maces have served as the *insignia* of noble Orientals.

en.name: Castle
description: Just like the nearby town of Alcácer do Sal, Sesimbra also consisted of two perfectly autonomous urban centres. Unlike the former Roman town of Salacia, though, where an escarpment of only a few dozen metres separated the walls of the medina from the more recently built riverside houses, the old fortified settlement of Sesimbra was located several hundred metres from the riverside village. In the late Middle Ages, and certainly still in Islamic times, the fortification of Sesimbra had both a topography and residential area that were similar to those found at the fortresses of Palmela and Almada. Both also had coastal quarters inhabited by fishermen and sailors with an area of 4 hectares surrounded by an 800-m. perimeter wall and a distant port area.

es.name: Castillo
description: Al igual que la vecina Alcácer do Sal, también Sesimbra estaba formada por dos núcleos urbanos perfectamente autónomos. Al contrario, sin embargo, que la antigua Salacia, donde un declive de escasas decenas de metros separa las murallas de la *medina* de las últimas casas de la ribera, el antiguo pueblo fortificado de Sesimbra dista unos centenares de metros de la población ribereña. En la Alta Edad Media, y ciertamente todavía en época musulmana, la fortificación de Sesimbra, con sus 4 ha acordonadas por un perímetro amurallado de 800 m y su distante arrabal portuario, tendría una topografía y un área residencial similares a las de las fortalezas de Palmela y Almada, estas también con barrios costeros de pescadores y marineros.

en.name: *The French Colonies. Book 26. M. de Brazza's Exploration 1875–79. His treaty with Makoko.*
short_description: In September 1880, the explorer Pierre Savorgnan de Brazza signed a treaty with Makoko, the Chief of the Bateke (Anziku Kingdom) laying out the new borders of the Congo. The French government ratified this treaty in 1882. Savorgnan de Brazza was henceforth put forward by Jules Ferry's government as the perfect example of non-violent victory, contrasting him with England's Henry Morton Stanley, his rival in this region. Savorgnan de Brazza's image as a "civiliser" became a central theme of colonial propaganda, as we can see from this image.
artist: Engraver: L. Geisler; artist; G. Dascher
keywords: Congo; France; colonies; Savorgnan de Brazza

fr.name: *Les Colonies françaises. Cahier n°26, Congo français. Exploration de M. de Brazza 1875–79. Son traité avec Makoko*
short_description: En septembre 1880, sans avoir reçu de mandat officiel, l’explorateur Pierre Savorgnan de Brazza signe un traité avec le chef des Bétékés (royaume du Makoko), sur les bords du Congo. Le gouvernement français ratifie ce traité en 1882. Savorgnan de Brazza est désormais mis en avant par le gouvernement Ferry comme celui qui a réussi à obtenir une victoire sans combat, et on l’oppose à l’Anglais Stanley, son concurrent dans la région. La propagande coloniale s’empare donc, comme sur ce dessin, de l’image de Savorgnan de Brazza présenté comme un héros « civilisateur ».

en.name: Madrasa al-Rukniyya
description:
Built by Rukn al-Din Mengüverish al-Falaki, the building is made of two square sections, the smaller one is a mausoleum (*turba*) and the larger one a mosque. The minaret is a recent addition and did not exist in the original plan. The plan of a courtyard surrounded by three *riwaqs* shows the decorative stone-carving techniques that were influenced by Northern Syria and even Anatolia. This façade decoration is rare, with beautiful geometric *kufic* designs over the windows and over the gate. The *madrasa* also features the first Ayyubid courtyard to be covered by a dome. The mausoleum is bigger than the courtyard and the non-symmetrical portico. Meanwhile, the interior of the prayer-hall displays the simple elegance of Ayyubid architecture. The inscriptions on the mausoleum indicate that it once belonged to the *madrasa* complex; indeed mausoleums are often the only surviving evidence of a *madrasa*’s existence. This is the case of the Madrasa al-Rukniyya, which currently functions as a mosque.  
Generally speaking, up until the end of the 6th/12th century, the tambours of mausoleums were made of brick, indicating the strong Eastern influence of these architectural types. By the 7th/13th century, however, the influence of northern Syria and Aleppo becomes stronger and the use of stone more dominant. This *madrasa* is a good example to illustrate this point.

ar.name: ضريح السيدة رقية.
description:
ينسب المبنى إلى سيدة صالحة تدعى رقية. وليس هناك ما يؤكد هوية السيدة رقية التي سمي المبنى باسمها، وربما تكون هذه السيدة هي ابنة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وزوجة عثمان بن عفان ثالث الخلفاء الراشدين (حكم في الفترة 23 – 35 هـ / 644 – 656 م). ويعتبر المبنى أحد مشاهد الرؤية التي أنشأها الفاطميون في مصر، حيث كان الناس يصعدون إلى سطحه لاستطلاع الهلال لتحديد أوائل الشهور العربية في التقويم الإسلامي.  
  
والجزء المتبقي من المبنى عبارة عن بناء مستطيل مقسم إلى ثلاثة أجزاء؛ الجزء الأوسط، وهو الأكبر، مربع المسقط طول ضلعه 12 م مغطى بقبة ويفتح على الجزءين الجانبيين المستطيلين بواسطة فتحتين ذات عتب أفقي. وأهم ما يميز المبنى منطقة الانتقال من المربع إلى دائرة القبة، وتتكون هذه المنطقة من صفوف من حنيات معقودة صغيرة تذكر بالمقرنصات، وهي بذلك تمثل نقطة تحول في تصميم القبة التي كانت منطقة الانتقال فيها تتكون من حنيات كبيرة في زوايا المربع. وظهرت بعدها المقرنصات في قباب العصر الأيوبي. ويوجد حول دائرة القبة شريط من كتابة كوفية تتضمن آيات قرآنية، ويعتبر هذا الشريط أقدم نقش كتابي تسجيلي على ضريح في مصر. وفتحت برقبة القبة المثمنة ثمانية شبابيك جصية، في كل ضلع شباكان. وكان يزخرف أسفل هذه الشبابيك زخارف جصية جميلة تعتبر نموذجاً بديعاً لزخارف الأرابسك في العصر الفاطمي. والقبة من الخارج مفصصة الشكل.

هذا الضريح أحد الأعمال الخيرية التي قامت بها زوجة الخليفة الفاطمي "الآمر بأحكام الله"، وذلك تخليداً لذكرى السيدة رقية، ابنة الإمام علي بن أبي طالب، رابع الخلفاء الراشدين. وقبة الضريح من القباب الرشيقة، المزخرفة من الخارج بزخارف مضلَّعة، تشبه القباب المضلَّعة في شمال إفريقيا. كما تتميَّز المنطقة الانتقالية للقبة، بظهور عنصر جديد في العمارة الإسلامية، وهو حنيات معقودة، وتطور هذا العنصر في العصر الأيوبي إلى المقرنص.
artist: السيدة علم الآمرية زوجة الخليفة الفاطمي الآمر بأحكام الله (حكم في الفترة 495 – 524 هـ / 1101 – 1130 م).

en.name: Shrine (Mausoleum) of Sayyida Ruqayya.
description:
The Shrine is associated with the venerated lady known as Al-Sayyida Ruqayya, daughter of the Imam 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib, the fourth Righteously Guided Caliph (*Rashidun*). This monument was also used as a viewing platform where visitors could climb to the roof and view the new moon. In this way the beginning of the Arabic months in the Islamic calendar could be pinpointed.  
What remains of the building is rectangular with a tripartite structure. The biggest, middle section is square in plan with all four sides measuring 12 m, and it is covered by a dome. It opens out onto two side bays, which are rectangular in shape, by means of two entrances with horizontal lintels.  
One of the most important and distinctive features of this monument is in the middle section's transition zone from the square to the drum of the dome. The transition is made by a row of small keel-arched niches resembling *muqarnas*, a device that represents a transformation in the design and layout of dome architecture, in which previously the zone of transition had consisted of large keel-arched openings in the corners of the square. Following the innovative breakthrough of this dome, *muqarnas* appeared in the domes of the Ayyubid period.  
Around the drum of the dome, is an inscription band in *kufic* script containing Qur'anic verses. This band is considered the oldest epigraphic inscription to be seen on a mausoleum in Egypt. The base of the octagonal dome is characterised by eight windows in stucco; there are two windows on each side. The lower parts of these windows are embellished with beautiful stucco work, considered to be a unique example of arabesque decoration in the Fatimid period. The dome from the outside is lobed in shape.

One of the charitable constructions commissioned by the wife of the Fatimid caliph, al-Amir bi Ahkam Allah, the shrine was dedicated to the memory of Sayyida Ruqayya, daughter of Imam 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib, the fourth Righteously Guided Caliph. A prominent architectural feature of the building is the transition zone of the dome composed of arched niches, which later developed, in the Ayyubid period, into the *muqarnas* or stalactite decoration.
artist: Al-Sayyida Ulam al-Amiriyya, the wife of the Fatimid caliph, al-Amir bi-Ahkam Allah (r. AH 495–524 / AD 1101–30).
keywords: Arabesque; keel-arched corner opening; vegetal stucco decoration; shrine; mausoleum; funerary architecture; dome; transition zone of a dome.
partner: Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities, Supreme Council of Antiquities

es.name: Mausoleo de Sayyida Ruqayya.
description:
El santuario se relaciona con la venerada al-Sayyida Ruqayya, hija del imán Ali ibn Abi Talib, el cuarto califa ortodoxo *(rashidun)*. El tejado de este monumento se usó también como mirador y desde él los visitantes observaban la luna nueva, que marca el inicio de los meses del calendario islámico.  
La estructura que se conserva es un espacio rectangular tripartito. La parte central, mayor, es cuadrada (12 m de lado) y está cubierta por una cúpula; se comunica con las salas adyacentes por dos vanos adintelados.  
Una de las características importantes y distintivas de este monumento es la zona de transición entre el cuadrado de la planta y el tambor de la cúpula. Presenta una fila de pequeños nichos con arcos agudos que parecen enormes mocárabes, elemento que pone de manifiesto una transformación del diseño y la estructura de la arquitectura de cúpulas, cuya zona de transición consistía hasta entonces en grandes aberturas con arcos agudos en los ángulos. Esta innovación introdujo después los mocárabes en las cúpulas del periodo ayyubí.  
En torno al tambor de la cúpula se aprecia una franja de inscripción en caligrafía cúfica con versículos del Corán, considerada la inscripción epigráfica más antigua de los mausoleos egipcios. En el tambor octogonal se abren 16 ventanas de estuco, dos por lado. La parte inferior de estas ventanas está adornada con hermosos trabajos de estuco que constituyen un ejemplo único de la decoración arabesca del periodo fatimí. Desde el exterior, la cúpula tiene forma lobulada.

Este santuario, patrocinado por la esposa del califa fatimí al-Amir bi-Ahkam Allah, se dedicó a la memoria de Sayyida Ruqayya, hija del imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, cuarto califa ortodoxo. Su principal característica es la transición a la cúpula, compuesta por nichos con arco. Esta solución dio lugar en época ayyubí a las zonas de transición con mocárabes.
artist: Al-Sayyida Ulam al-Amiriyya, esposa del califa fatimí al-Amir bi-Ahkam Allah (r. 495-524 / 1101-30).
keywords: La inscripción de la cúpula informa del patrocinador y la fecha de construcción.
tags: La inscripción de la cúpula informa del patrocinador y la fecha de construcción.
partner: Ministry of Culture,Supreme Council of Antiquities

fr.name: Mausolée de Sayyida Ruqayya.
description:
Ce mausolée est celui d'al-Sayyida Ruqayya, fille de l'imam Ali Ibn Taleb, quatrième des “Califes bien guidés” (*Rachidoun*). Le monument remplit aussi la fonction de terrasse pour l'observation de la nouvelle lune qui marque le début des mois du calendrier islamique.  
Les vestiges restants se présentent sous forme d'un bâtiment rectangulaire à structure en trois parties. La section centrale de plan carré de 12 m de côté est recouverte d'une coupole. Deux ouvertures à linteau horizontal en permettent l'accès.  
L'une des caractéristiques les plus importantes de ce monument est la zone de transition entre le carré formé par les murs et le tambour circulaire de la coupole. Elle se compose d'une rangée de petites niches en carène ressemblant à des *mouqarnas*, alors que, traditionnellement, elle aurait dû faire appel à de grandes ouvertures en carène aux angles du carré. Cette innovation annonce l'apparition des *mouqaranas* dans les coupoles ayyoubides.  
Autour du tambour court un bandeau épigraphique en style coufique contenant des versets du Coran. Il est considéré comme la plus ancienne inscription de mausolée en égypte. La base de la coupole octogonale comprend huit fenêtres en stuc, deux sur chaque face. Leur partie inférieure est ornée d'un remarquable travail de stuc, exemple unique de décor d'arabesques de la période fatimide. L'extérieur de la coupole est de forme lobée.

L'un des édifices de bienfaisance commandité par la femme du calife fatimide al-Amir bi Ahkam Allah est le mausolée dédié à la mémoire de Sayyida Ruqayya, fille de l'imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, le quatrième des “califes bien guidés”. L'une des caractéristiques les plus importantes de ce monument est la zone de transition à la base du dôme ; elle est composée de niches en forme d'arcs qui se développeront ultérieurement, durant la période ayyoubide, en *mouqarnas* ou décorations en stalactite.
keywords: Arabesques ; ouvertures d’angle en carène ; décoration végétale en stuc ; mausolées ; architecture funéraire ; dôme ; zone de transition dans un dôme.
tags: zone de transition dans un dôme.
partner: Ministry of Culture,Supreme Council of Antiquities

de.name: Chor
description: Der Chor über nahezu quadratischem Grundriss bildet den architektonischen Höhepunkt der Raumgestaltung. Vom Langhaus durch einen mächtigen, weit eingezogenen Triumphbogen separiert, ist er ganz als Zentralbau gestaltet, wobei die längsovale Gestalt des Kuppelgewölbes erst erkennbar wird, wenn man in den Raum eintritt. Wuchtige abgeschrägte Pfeiler bilden die Wiederlager für Tonnengewölbe von geringer Tiefe, die nach Norden und Süden kurze Kreuzarme sowie nach Osten die Nische des Hochaltars bilden.
artist: Diego Francesco Carlone und Paolo d’Allio

en.name: Choir
description: The choir, built on an almost quadratic ground plan, forms the highpoint of the spatial arrangement. Separated from the nave by a massive, deeply retraced triumphal arch, it is designed as a centralised building, whereby the lengthwise oval design of the domical vault is only apparent on entering the space. Massive bevelled piers provide the support for the shallow barrel vaults which form short cross-arms to the north and south as well as the niche for the high altar to the east.

en.name: Nature morte à la corbeille de verres et aux roses blanches
description:
This is a still life consisting of a basket of glasses, a present-day picture postcard of Romont Castle, an empty lemonade bottle with the label “Fribourg” and a vase of white roses. A rose branch with a shoot and a withered petal lies next to it. The basket covers the upper edge of a postcard lying underneath, on which a biblical scene (the healing of Tobias) appears.  
  
The work consists of glass with facet cut. It was created for the inauguration of the permanent exhibition of reverse glass at the Vitromusée Romont in October 2006, when the museum was renovated and its collection extended to include not only stained glass but glass art in general. Two compositional elements reference this context: the postcard of Romont Castle, which houses the museum, and the postcard depicting a reverse painting on glass by Swiss artist Franz Thaddäus Menteler the Younger (1751–94) from 1780. The glass basket is also a reference to the 17th-century Alsatian Mannerist Sébastien Stoskopff.  
  
The painting is notable for the delicate light effects on the glasses and the play between translucence and reflection of the vase and bottle. In Yves Siffer’s work, almost all the objects depicted recall human activities and evoke everyday life. His still life works are often allegories of transience.
keywords: still life; bottle; flowers; glass; basket; postcard
materials: Reverse painting on glass in acrylic paint
tags: Reverse painting on glass in acrylic paint

cs.name: Stříbrný oltář a korunovační souprava
names: Moravské palladium, Thaumaturga, Madona Starobrněnská, Gemma Moraviae
description: Oltář je vytvořen z měděného plechu, pokrytého plátkovým stříbrem a částečně zlaceného. Některé části jsou lité. V kartuších pod obrazem a na šesti tepaných svícnech jsou na emailu malovány znaky a inicilály opata O. Zirkla.

Korunovace zázračného obrazu P. Marie v Brně byla jednou z největších církevních slavností na českém území. K této příležitosti objednali augustiniáni pro obraz darovaný dle tradice císařem Karlem IV. retabulum a liturgickou soupravu v proslulé augsburské zlatnické dílně. Obrazu se připisovala záchrana Brna za švédského obléhání na konci Třicetileté války i uzdravení soukromých osob a další zázraky. Před Thaumaturgou byli tradičně oddávání představitelé významných aristokratických rodů na Moravě.
artist: Johann Georg Herkommer (1680/90 Augsburg – 1754 Augsburg), Christian Friedrich Rudoplh, Jan Jiří Schauberger (?, před 1725 Vídeň, činný v Olomouci – 1744 Brno),  František Richter
history: Korunovace zázračného obrazu P. Marie v Brně byla jednou z největších církevních slavností na českém území. K této příležitosti objednali augustiniáni pro obraz Madony retabulum v proslulé augsburské zlatnické dílně. Architekturu oltáře navrhl Ch. F. Rudolph a realizoval jej zřejmě jeho příbuzný J. G. Herkommer. Modely andělů vytvořil ale pravděpodobně brněnský sochař Schauberger. Oltář, převezený z Augsburgu po Dunaji, byl instalován v nově zbudované mariánské kapli kostela sv. Tomáše, vyzdobené malbou J. J. Etgense. R. 1776 byl při čištění oltář doplněn o zdobné prvky brněnským stříbrníkem Richterem. R. 1783 byl přenesen při přesunu konventu do zrušeného kláštera cisterciaček na Starém Brně, kde dnes tvoří součást hlavního oltáře kostela nanebevzetí P. Marie.
keywords: Eucharistie, pašije, monstrance, relikviář

en.name: Silver Altar and Coronation Set
names: The Moravian palladium; Thaumaturga; The Madonna of Old Brno
description: The altar is copper covered with silver plate, partially gilded. Some parts are cast. Cartouches under the picture and six wrought candlesticks feature emblems and the initials of Abbot O. Zirkl painted on enamel.

The Coronation of the Miraculous Picture of the Virgin Mary in Brno was one of the biggest religious celebrations to take place in Czech territory. For the occasion and to complement the picture, the Augustinians ordered a retable and a liturgical set from the famous goldsmiths’ workshop in Augsburg, said to have been donated by Emperor Charles IV. The image was credited with the salvation of Brno from the Swedish siege at the end of the Thirty Years’ War and was thought to have healing properties and bring about other miracles. Members of major Moravian aristocratic families were traditionally married before the Thaumaturga.
artist: Augustinian Monastery – Hermits of St. Thomas the Apostle, Provost Ondřej Zirckl (1722–1736)
Johann Georg Herkommer (1680/90–1754), Christian Friedrich Rudolph, Jan Jiří Schauberger (? before 1725 Vienna, active in Olomouc – 1744 Brno), František Richter, Mathias Schlössinger?
history: The Coronation of the Miraculous Picture of the Virgin Mary in Brno was one of the biggest religious celebrations to take place in Czech territory. On the occasion, the Augustinians ordered a retable and a liturgical set from the famous goldsmiths’ workshop in Augsburg, to complement the picture. The altar was designed by C. F. Rudolph and probably executed by J. G. Herkommer, a relative. The models of angels were possibly created by Schauberger, a sculptor from Brno. The altarpiece, transported from Augsburg on the Danube, was installed in the newly constructed Marian Chapel in the Church of St. Thomas and decorated with J. J. Etgens’s paintings. In 1776, during cleaning, decorative elements were added by a Brno silversmith, Richter. In 1783 it was transferred to the dissolved Cistercian convent in Old Brno (acquired by the Augustinian order) where it now makes up part of the high altar in the Church of the Assumption of the Virgin Mary.
keywords: Eucharist, Passion, monstrance, reliquary

en.name: Covered al-Buzuriyya Market
description: Before the celebrations of Mawlid al-Nabawi (Feast of the Birth of the Prophet), shops in the historic Buzuriyya market in Damascus are filled with many types of sweets and chocolates. The most important sweet for Aid al-Mawlid is the *Mulabbas*, which consists of roasted almonds coated with a thin layer of sugar mixed with rose water. The shopkeepers arrange the various sweets inside the shops, while they place large bags of *Mulabbas* at the entrance to attract customers. The mosques organise the Mawlid celebrations, which take place between the Maghrib and Isha prayers in the evening, and a number of women like to host a Mawlid party in their homes. During the celebration of Mawlid, *Mulabbas* are distributed to all celebrants. Damascenes believe it is important to cook white food or serve white sweets on religious occasions, in order to greet the coming days with optimism symbolised by the colour white.

cs.name: Zahradní průčelí
description: Jedenáctiosé zahradní průčelí zámku bylo inspirováno zahradním průčelím, které Hildebrandt vytvořil pro knížete-arcibiskupa Franze Antona Harracha a jeho letní palác Mirabell v Salcburku. V dekoraci fasády je patrné střídmé stupňování ke střední ose s portálem a trojúhelníkově završeným oknem středního patra, vrcholící atikou pro Hildebrandta typického zvlněného tvaru. Reprezentativní část síla je zdůrazněna rytmem vysokých pilastrů a balustrádou se sochařskou výzdobou.
artist: Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt (1668 Janov – 1745 Vídeň)

en.name: Garden frontage
description: The eleven-axis garden frontage was inspired by one designed by Hildebrandt for Count Archbishop Franz Anton Harrach in his Mirabell summer palace in Salzburg. Its frontage decoration escalates towards the central axis, with a portal and a middle-floor window crowned with a triangle, and peaking in a parapet of sinuous shape, so typical of Hildebrandt. The reception area of the palace is accentuated by the rhythm of tall pilasters and a balustrade with sculpted decoration.
artist: Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt (1668 Genoa – 1745 Vienna)

ar.name: كِسرة من زبدية.
description:
كِسرة فخارية مكوَّنة من الجزء المركزي والحافة العلوية لزبدية ذات قاعدة وجانب مائل، يبدو عليها شكل دائري منقوش بالأرابيسك. يمكن أن يُرى على الجزء العلوي شذرات لحزمة من الكلمات العربية المكتوبة بخط اليد. والتقنية المستخدمة، المعروفة باسم **sgraffito** ( وتعني بالإيطالية الكتابة العشوائية)، تستلزم تغطيس الإناء في طين مائع خفيف اللون يُدعى مزيج التغطيس. وبواسطة أداة حادة يُخدش الشكل المطلوب داخل المزيج، مبرزاً المادة الطينية خلال رسم التصميم. بعدئذ، يُزجَّج الإناء بطبقة صقيلة ويُشوى. إن الشكل المنقوش يخلق تغايراً، بحيث يُبدي اللونَ الغامق للطين، بينما تساهم الفراغات بين الخطوط في إبراز لون المزيج الفاتح. والطبقة الشفافة للزبدية مؤلفة من مركَّب الزجاج وأكسيد الرصاص الأصفر. إن كلفة تصنيع هذا النوع من الأواني أقل من كلفة تلك المصنوعة من الخزف، وبالتالي تلبي حاجات الزبائن الأقل ثراءً، الذين، شأنهم شأن الزبائن الأغنى، يطمحون ويميلون إلى حيازة أوانٍ مزجَّجة ومزخرفة بالخطوط والرسوم.  
لقد حافظت مدينة الفسطاط على مكانتها الحيوية كمدينة تجارية خلال العهد المملوكي (647- 922 / 1250- 1517)، على الرغم من فقدانها بعضاً من شهرتها لصالح القاهرة التي استوعبتها بعد أن تأسست على يد المماليك.

في وقت من الأوقات، كان هذا جزءاً من طاسة لافتة، عميقة الجدران، مُزيَّنة بأسلوب الحزّ، أو الثلم، المعروف باسم **السغرافيتو** (وهي كلمة تعني الخربشة، أو الحكّ). كان صنع مثل هذه الخزفيات ذات الألوان الأحادية، أقل كلفة من صنع الخزفيات مُتعدِّدة الألوان، مما جعلها في متناول من هم أقلّ يُسْراً من الناس.
holder: متحف وصالة فنون كيلفينغروف، متاحف غلاسكو.
keywords: أرابيسك؛ زخرفة كتابية.
materials: فخار مزجَّج  بقشرة رقيقة، مع زخارف منقوشة.
tags: فخار مزجَّج بقشرة رقيقة، مع زخارف منقوشة.

en.name: Bowl fragment.
description:
An earthenware fragment that formed the centre and part of the rim of a footed and steep-sided bowl, showing a roundel embellished with an incised arabesque decoration; on the rim can be seen fragments of a band of Arabic calligraphic text. The technique, known as *sgraffito* (an Italian word meaning to scratch), involves dipping the vessel into a lighter coloured liquefied clay, known as a slip. With the aid of a pointed tool, the pattern is scratched into the slip, revealing parts of the clay as the design is drawn. The vessel is then glazed and fired. The incised pattern creates contrast; it reveals the colour of the darker clay, while the spaces between the lines show the lighter slip. The glaze on this bowl is a transparent ochre-yellow colour. This type of vessel was less costly to make than coloured ceramics, and therefore fulfilled the demands of the less affluent customers, who had just as much aspiration and taste for glazed wares with decorative texts and patterns, as did the wealthier customers.  
  
The city of Fustat continued to be an active commercial city during the Mamluk period (AH 647–922 / AD 1250–1517), although it had lost some of its fame to Cairo, which was established by the Mamluks and subsequently subsumed by her.

This was once part of an impressive steep-sided bowl, decorated using an incising method called *sgraffito* – to scratch. It was less costly to make such monochrome ceramics in comparison to multicoloured ceramics, which made them more affordable to comparatively less-affluent people.
holder: Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum, Glasgow Museums.
keywords: Arabesque; calligraphy
materials: Earthenware, slip-coated and glazed, with incised decoration.
tags: Earthenware, slip-coated and glazed, with incised decoration.

es.name: Fragmento de cuenco.
description:
Cuenco de barro con pie y pared muy inclinada, del que se conserva el centro y parte de la pared. Presenta un medallón bellamente decorado con arabescos incisos, y en la pared se aprecian fragmentos de una banda caligráfica. Está decorado con la técnica del esgrafiado, que consiste en ejecutar un dibujo con un instrumento incisivo (el grafio) sobre la capa de engobe hasta llegar a la arcilla; después, la pieza se vidria y se cuece. La incisión crea un contraste entre el dibujo trazado, que aparece en el color oscuro de la arcilla, y los espacios sin decorar, que quedan en el color claro del engobe. El vidriado de este cuenco es amarillo ocre transparente. Este tipo de recipiente era menos costoso que los coloreados y servía para satisfacer la demanda de clientes menos pudientes pero con las mismas pretensiones y el mismo gusto por artículos vidriados decorados con textos y dibujos que clientes más ricos.  
Durante el periodo mameluco (647-922 / 1250-1517), Fustat siguió teniendo una gran actividad comercial pese a perder parte de su fama en beneficio de El Cairo, ciudad construida por los mamelucos y que acabó englobándola.

Fragmento de un impresionante cuenco de paredes casi verticales, decorado con la técnica del esgrafiado. Estas cerámicas monocromas eran menos costosas de producir que las de múltiples colores y, por tanto, más asequibles para clientes menos pudientes.
holder: Galería de Arte y Museo Kelvingrove, Museos de Glasgow.
dates: Siglo VIII de la Hégira / XIV d. C.
keywords: decoración de arabesco; caligrafía.
materials: Cerámica con engobe y vidriada, decoración incisa.
tags: Cerámica con engobe y vidriada, decoración incisa.

fr.name: Fragment de coupe.
description:
Fragment de céramique qui constituait le centre et une partie du bord d'une coupe sur piédouche, à parois fortement inclinées. Il présente un rondeau orné d'un décor d'arabesques incisé. Sur le bord subsistent des traces d'un bandeau de texte calligraphique arabe. La technique appelée *sgraffito* (esgrafié) consistait à plonger l'objet dans une argile liquéfiée de couleur plus claire, l'engobe. À l'aide d'un outil pointu, le motif était gratté dans l'engobe, faisant ainsi apparaître la base d'argile. L'objet était ensuite vernis et cuit. Le motif esgrafié produit un contraste. Il révèle et met en valeur la couleur plus foncée de l'argile tandis que les champs compris entre les lignes gravées conservent la teinte de l'engobe. La glaçure est ici de couleur ocre-jaune transparente. Ce type de récipient était de réalisation plus économique que celle des céramiques de couleur et répondait à la demande de clients moins fortunés, qui appréciaient cependant le style des objets vernis à textes et motifs décoratifs.  
La ville de Fustat conserva son rôle commercial au cours de la période mamelouke (647-922/1250-1517), bien qu'elle ait commencé à perdre de son prestige au profit du Caire, fondé par les Mamelouks et qui allait plus tard l'absorber.
holder: Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum, Glasgow Museums.
dates: VIIIe siècle de l’Hégire (XIVe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: décoration d’arabesques ; calligraphie
materials: Céramique, engobe à décoration incisée sous glaçure.
tags: Céramique, engobe à décoration incisée sous glaçure.

en.name: Church of Santa María Magdalena
names: Church and Bell Tower of Santa María Magdalena (option)
description:
The Mudéjar building of the Parish Church of Santa María Magdalena has a single nave with a polygonal and seven-sided apse. As is usual in Mudé- jar architecture it has no buttresses, so that the smooth face of the apse allowed for brickwork decoration in relief without the visual break that buttressing would have caused. Under the windows of the apse are large panels with interlaced *mixtilineos* arches, and, above the windows, other panels with branched crosses, which form a diamond-shaped honeycomb.  
A Baroque renovation of between 1727 and 1730 inverted the orientation of the church, turning the apse into the gable end and opening up an entrance door in the new façade. This transformation also affected the interior of the church, although it respected the vaulting of the sanctuary and the three aisles of the nave. At the foot of the church, in calle Mayor, there is the magnificent bell tower of the Magdalena. This tower, built on a square ground plan, is a copy of the towers of San Martín and el Salvador in the city of Teruel, which it resembles both in its interior, in the form of a minaret, like the Giralda in Seville, and also because of the decoration on the outside of brickwork in relief and enamelled ceramics. The extensive alteration to the belfry of the tower was to suit Baroque taste between 1678 and 1695. The present tower is the result of a restoration carried out by the architect Francisco Iñiguez in 1970.

es.name: Iglesia de Santa María Magdalena
names: Iglesia y torre-campanario de Santa María Magdalena (opción)
description:
La fábrica mudéjar de la iglesia parroquial de Santa María Magdalena responde al tipo de una sola nave, con un ábside poligonal de siete lados que, como es habitual en la arquitectura mudéjar, carece de contrafuertes, para que el facetamiento limpio del ábside permita desarrollar una decoración en ladrillo resaltado sin los cortes visuales que causaría la existencia de los contrafuertes. La decoración del ábside, bajo los ventanales, es de grandes paños formados por *arcos mixtilíneos* entrecruzados y, sobre los ventanales, otros paños a base de cruces de múltiples brazos formando una retícula de rombos.  
Una reforma barroca, realizada entre 1727 y 1730, invirtió la orientación de la iglesia, convirtiendo el ábside en hastial de los pies y abriendo una puerta de acceso en la nueva fachada. Esta transformación afectó también al aspecto interior de la iglesia, aunque respetó las bóvedas de crucería del presbiterio y de los tres tramos de la nave. A los pies de la nave, sobre la calle Mayor, se alza la magnífica torre-campanario de la Magdalena, de planta cuadrada, émula de las torres de San Martín y del Salvador de la ciudad de Teruel, a las que se asemeja tanto por su disposición interior de *alminar*, al estilo de la Giralda de Sevilla, como por la decoración exterior de ladrillo resaltado y cerámica vidriada. El cuerpo de campanas de la torre fue transformado profundamente entre 1678 y 1695 en un sentido barroco. El actual se debe a una restauración realizada por el arquitecto Francisco Íñiguez en 1970.

en.name: J.P.W. Prototype
description: Jean-Pierre Wimille was a renowned French racing driver. He won several Grand Prix races and triumphed at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 1937 and 1939. After being part of the French Resistance during World War II, Wimille collaborated with engineer M. Viel to create this small post-war car. The design was drawn by Philippe Charbonneaux, while the body was constructed by Chapron on a tubular chassis with four independent wheels. The driver was positioned centrally, with space for one passenger on each side. The engine was centrally located at the rear. Its aerodynamic design, featuring a large plexiglass windshield and a small rear window, was particularly striking. The car on display is the first of three built between 1946 and 1948. Tragically, Wimille died in a crash in 1949 while driving a Simca-Gordini during practice for the Argentine Grand Prix.
keywords: Experimental; post-war; steel construction; unique design

ar.name: وعاء مغطى بتصميم نافر بنقوش عربية بالخط الكوفي
description: القطعة عبارة عن وعاء من الآستيتيت (فخار زلق أملس ) دائري ذو غطاء مسطح رقيق ومقبض بشكل أذن جناحية الذي له مقطع بشكل حبة الفطر في المركز.وحول السطح الخارجي للغطاء يوجد عصابة من التهشير العرضاني وعصابة أخرى بنفس العرض تتقاطع مع قطر الغطاء. وهذه العصابة أيضا مهشرة عرضانيا في نصفها حتى التقاطع مع المقبض وبعدها تصبح شفافة ومملوءة فقط بنقوش نافرة مرتفعة وتحت ذلك تغطي السطح الباقي للغطاء والوعاء له جوانب مستقيمة مع حدود علوية وسفلية  للتهشير العرضاني والتي تحيط بعصابة نافرة من النقوش. والأساس محفور لتشكيل نقش عربي نافر في طراز خط زاوي مثل الكوفي. وأعلى الأحرف الأطول تنتهي بأوراق وأزهار وهي مادة تخطيط شائعة في القرن العاشر وعلى الجوانب المقابلة للوعاء هناك مقابض تشبة القضيب ذات تكوين عميق على حوافها الخارجية.والمنطقة التي يتصل بها كل مقبض بالوعاء تحدد بتهشير عرضاني.
dates: اواخر القرن الثاني إلى أواخر القرن الرابع الهجري /القرن العاشر الميلادي

en.name: Covered Vessel with Relief Design of Arabic Inscription in *Kufic* Script
description:
A circular steatite vessel with a thin, flat lid with a vertical, eared wing handle that has a mushroom-shaped cut-out in the center. Around the exterior of the lid is a band of cross-hatching, and another band of the same width crossing the diameter of the lid. This band is also cross-hatched on one half, up to where it intersects with the handle, then becomes "transparent," filled only with the raised relief inscription beneath that covers the remaining surface of the lid.  
The vessel has straight sides with an upper and lower border of cross-hatching, enclosing a relief band of inscription. The stone is carved to form an Arabic inscription in relief, in an angular script style known as *Kufic*. The tops of the taller letters end in leaves and flowers, a popular calligraphic device in the 10th century. On opposing sides of the vessel are bar-like handles with deep gouges on their outer edges. The area where each handle attaches to the vessel is bordered by cross-hatching.
dates: Hegira Late 2nd to late 4th / AD 10th century
keywords: Covered; Bowl; Stone; Mineral; Steatite; Nishapur; Khorasan; Iran; Asia; Persian

en.name: Valeria Mengarini Rossetti (the wife of an Italian military officer) visiting Menfi (Egypt), escorted by her brother-in-law Roberto Rossetti (an Italian lawyer who migrated to Egypt)
short_description:
During the 19th century, the number of Europeans who could engage in leisure travel steadily increased, and tourism began to flourish. Ancient Egypt became an attractive tourist destination for the European elites. Fascination for Egyptian antiquities and the cultural exoticism were sources of interest.  
Near Egyptian ruins, tourist could also enjoy the exotic experience of riding a camel.

ar.name: عباءة الشيخ محمد الخليلي.
description:
القطعة عبارة عن عباءَة تتكون من قطع متراصة صغيرة الحجم (3×3 سم تقريباً) من الحرير والقطن، حيكت معاً بخيوط صوفية طولية وأحياناً عرضية على شكل معينات ذات ألوان متبادلة تشتمل على الأصفر والأحمر والأخضر والأسود. وتم ترتيب المعينات ضمن مستطيلات جرى حبكها بشكل طولي، بحيث جعلت لابسها (الشيخ محمد الخليلي) يبدو أطول قامة مما هو عليه في واقع الأمر. حيك على ظهر العباءَة ما بين الكتفين مربع يحوي دائرة تتكوّن من معينات مرتبة في دوائر تصغر تدريجياً باتجاه مركز الدائرة مما يعطيها عمقاً كبيراً وفخامة. وغطى مثلثان من اللون الأحمر زاويتان متقابلتان من زاويا المربع، وأخذت الزاويتان الأخريان لوناً أسود. وللعباءة أكمام نصفية، ويوجد في الجزء السفلي منها شريط من الحرير الأخضر.ويوحي هذا الطراز من العباءَات بزهد وورع لابسها، فالتشكيل من قطع قماش صغيرة جداً يجعلها تبدو وكأنها حيكت من بقايا أقمشة.وتعتبر عباءة الشيخ الخليلي من القطع النادرة التي وصلتنا بشكلها الكامل وبهذا الطراز الجميل.  
  
كان الشيخ محمد الخليلي من الأعلام الفقهاء في القدس، ومن أهم شخصيات فلسطين في ذلك الوقت. ونظراً لمكانته الخاصة، فقد دفن في المدرسة الأشرفية الواقعة على الجدار الغربي للحرم الشريف، وهذا شرف لم يحظ به إلا عدد قليل لا يتجاوز العشرة من الشخصيات الإسلامية الهامة عبر التاريخ. وحُفظت عباءة الشيخ الخليلي التي اشتهر بلبسها مدة تزيد على القرنين في الحجرة التي دفن فيها إلى أن تم نقلها إلى المتحف الإسلامي.

عباءة أهم فقهاء وشخصيات القدس العامة، في القرن 12 الهجري/18 الميلادي، كانت تغطِّي قبره. حيكت من قطع معينية الشكل، متراصة، صغيرة الحجم، من الحرير والقطن، وبتبادل الألوان: الأصفر والأحمر والأخضر والأسود. وللعباءة أكمام نصفية. وتُعتبر هذه العباءة من القطع النادرة التي وصلتنا بشكلها الكامل.
dates: قبل عام 1146 / 1734، خلال فترة حياة صاحبها.
keywords: حرير؛ صوف؛ عباءة؛ عباءة؛ قطن؛ نسيج.
materials: قطع صغيرة من نسيج من الحرير والقطن متعدد الألوان حيكت معاً بخيوط صوفية.

en.name: Cloak belonging to Sheikh Muhammad al-Khalili.
description:
A cloak ('*Aba'a*) or outer garment composed of small pieces (approximately 3 cm x 3 cm) sewn together. The pieces consist of woven silk and cotton stitched together with woollen thread. The background, in the form of polygons, is made up from interchanging colours that include yellow, red, green and black. The polygons are arranged within rectangles tightly woven in an elongated form, which would have made the wearer (Sheikh Muhammad al-Khalili) seem taller in stature than he was in reality. The woven section at the back of the garment between the shoulders is square, containing a circle of polygons arranged in circles, which become smaller by degrees as they move towards the centre of the circle. This gives the back of the cloak great depth and splendour. Two facing triangular sections in the corners of the square are red, while the two other corners are black. The garment has half sleeves finished with a band of green silk. This mode of outer garment was inspired by the asceticism and the piety of its wearer. It is made from very small pieces of cloth to make it appear as if it was woven from pieces of fabric. The Sheikh's cloak is considered a rarity, having survived in a complete state and in such beautiful condition.  
Sheikh Muhammad al-Khalili was among the scholars of *fiqh* (Islamic Jurisprudence) in Jerusalem and one of the most important personalities of Palestine at the time. In view of his distinctive position he was buried in the Madrasa al-Ashrafiyya located at the western wall of the Haram al-Sharif. This honour was bestowed on a select group which did not exceed 10 Islamic personalities over the course of history. Sheikh al-Khalili was renowned for wearing this cloak which was preserved for more than two centuries in his burial chamber until it was transferred to the Islamic Museum.

The cloak of a scholar of *fiqh* (Islamic jurisprudence) and one of the most important personalities of Palestine in the AH 12th / AD 18th century. It covered his tomb. It is woven from small polygonal pieces in cotton and silk. The coat has half sleeves. This garment is a rare example to have survived almost completely intact.
holder: Islamic Museum, al-Aqsa Mosque / al-Haram al-Sharif.
dates: Before hegira 1146 / AD 1734, during the lifetime of the original owner.
keywords: Silk; wool; garment; coat; cotton; textile; costume
materials: Polychrome silk and cotton woven together with woollen threads.
tags: Polychrome silk and cotton woven together with woollen threads.

es.name: Capa del *shaij* Muhammad al-Jalili.
description:
Capa (*abaa*) o prenda de ropa exterior hecha de pequeños trozos de tela de seda y algodón (de 3 × 3 cm aproximadamente) cosidos con hilo de lana. El fondo consta de polígonos de distintos colores –amarillo, rojo, verde y negro– dispuestos en el interior de rectángulos que están tejidos a lo largo para que el *sheij* Muhammad al-Jalili parecería más alto cuando visitera la prenda. La parte tejida que está en la espalda, entre los hombros, es cuadrada y contiene una composición de polígonos dispuestos en círculos que van disminuyendo de tamaño según se acercan al centro. Esta composición otorga profundidad y esplendor a la capa. En los ángulos, el cuadrado posee dos triángulos enfrentados de color rojo y otros dos de color negro. La prenda tiene medias mangas rematadas con una banda de seda verde. Este tipo de prenda exterior estaba inspirado en el ascetismo y la piedad de su portador. Las piezas de tela, muy pequeñas, dan la sensación de que la prenda está hecha con pequeños retales. Esta capa de *shaij* es una pieza única por su gran belleza y su impecable estado de conservación.  
Muhammad al-Jalili fue un estudioso de la jurisprudencia islámica *(fiqh)* de Jerusalén y una de las personalidades más importantes de su tiempo en Palestina. Dada su elevada posición, su tumba se ubicó en la madrasa al-Ashrafiyya, en el muro occidental del Haram al-Sharif. A lo largo de la historia, este honor solamente se ha concedido a un selecto grupo de no más de diez personalidades del Islam. Se sabe que el *sheij* al-Jalili vistió esta capa, que se conservó durante más de dos siglos en su cámara mortuoria hasta que se trasladó al Museo Islámico.

Capa de un estudioso de la jurisprudencia islámica *(fiqh)* y una de las grandes personalidades del siglo XII / XVIII. Sirvió también para cubrir su tumba. Está formada por pequeños trozos octogonales de algodón y seda. Es de media manga, y una pieza única por haberse conservado casi intacta.
dates: Antes de 1146 de la Hégira / 1734 d. C., en vida de su dueño.

fr.name: Manteau ayant appartenu au cheikh Muhammad al-Khalili.
description:
Manteau (*'aba'a*) ou vêtement de dessus composé de petites pièces de soie et de coton de 3 x 3 cm environ, cousues ensemble au fil de laine et donnant l'impression d'un tissage. Le fond à motif polygonal fait appel à diverses couleurs dont le jaune, le rouge, le vert et le noir. Les polygones sont disposés dans des rectangles de forme allongée qui devaient élancer la silhouette. Le haut du dos présente un cercle composé de polygones disposés en cercles de diamètre croissant à partir du centre de la composition. Ce procédé donne à cette partie une profondeur fascinante. Le cercle est contenu dans un carré qui délimite des écoinçons rouges et noirs. Les manches se terminent par une bande de soie verte. Ce type de manteau était inspiré par l'ascétisme et la piété de celui qui le portait. Il s'agit d'une pièce extrêmement rare, car peu de vêtements complets dans un tel état de conservation sont parvenus jusqu'à nous.  
Le *cheikh* Muhammad al-Khalili, qui faisait partie du cercle des experts en *fiqh* (jurisprudence islamique) à Jérusalem, était l'une des personnalités palestiniennes les plus importantes de l'époque. Cette position lui valut d'être inhumé dans la *madrasa* al-Achrafiyya, située près du mur occidental du Haram al-Charif, honneur accordé une dizaine de personnalités seulement au cours de l'Histoire. Le manteau fut conservé pendant plus de deux siècles dans la chambre funéraire, d'où il a été transféré au musée.

Manteau d’un expert en fiqh (droit islamique) qui fut l’une des plus importantes personnalités de Palestine au XIIe siècle H (XVIIIe siècle J.-C.), qui recouvrait sa tombe. Il est tissé à partir de petites pièces polygonales en coton et en soie. Ce manteau a des manches trois-quarts. Ce vêtement est l’un des rares qui soit conservé presque intact.
holder: Musée islamique, mosquée al-Aqsa / Haram al-Charif.
dates: Avant 1146 de l’Hégire / 1734 J.-C. ; pendant l’existence de son propriétaire d’origine.
keywords: Soie ; laine ; vêtements ; manteau ; coton ; textiles ; costume
materials: Tissu de soie et de coton polychrome avec fils de laine.
tags: Tissu de soie et de coton polychrome avec fils de laine.

ar.name: عاشقان يراقبان من قبل مرضعة
description:
رسم العمل العشّاق في عناق وثيق بفرشاة معین مصوّر ، أحد أشهر الرسامين الإيرانيين وأكثرهم إنتاجًا في القرن السابع عشر. كان الأزواج العاشقون الشباب موضوعًا شائعًا إلى حد ما في عصره وهم موجودون في اختلافات لا حصر لها. النسخة الحالية مشحونة جنسيًا ، تصور شابًا جورجيًا (يتميز بقبعته المصنوعة من الفرو) يعانق امرأة فارسية شابة. واثقة من نفسها ، توقف إيماءة يده اليسرى المتطلبة.تتوافر أدلة إضافية أخرى لتأريخ العمل كفن الخط المتضخم ، المميز لرسومات القرن السابع عشر. من المعروف أن هناك حوالي 12 رسومات بالفرشاة موجودة لمعين ؛ في كثير من الأحيان ، تظهر نفس تشكيلة الألوان التي تتكون من الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر بالإضافة إلى الحبر الأسود.  
  
يُعرف معين بأسلوبه المحافظ إلى حد ما ، حيث ظل صادقًا خلال مسيرته المهنية التي استمرت 60 عامًا ، على الأسلوب الذي وضعه رضا عباسي في بداية القرن السابع عشر. لذلك ، فإن الزخارف الأوروبية نادرة جدًا في أعماله. ومع ذلك ، في هذه العمل ، لم يقم فقط بدمج قطعة ثابتة من المحتمل أن تكون نابعة من صور وطبعات أوروبية - الستارة المقسمة بشكل متماثل والمرتفعة الحد - ولكن أيضًا امرأة عجوز تنظر من خلال الباب. كان موضوع المراقب غير المدعو يتمتع بشعبية كبيرة في إيران ، خاصة في القرن التاسع عشر ، مما يجعلها واحدة من أقدم التمثيلات لهذ ا النوع من الصور بتحديد.
dates: التاسع عشر من شوال 1089/  4 من ديسمبر 1678

en.name: Amorous couple observed by a wet nurse
description:
The brush drawing of a pair of lovers in close embrace is by Muʿin Musavvir, one of the most famous and prolific Iranian painters of the 17th century. Young amorous couples were a fairly popular subject in his time and they exist in countless variations. The present version is erotically charged, portraying a young Georgian man (distinguished by his fur cap) embracing a young Persian woman. Self-confident, she stops the demanding gesture of his left hand. Further dating evidence is provided by the swelling calligraphic line, characteristic of 17th century drawings. About a dozen brush drawings by Muʿin are known to exist; quite often, they show a similar palette consisting of red, green and ochre in addition to black ink  
  
Muʿin is known for his rather conservative style, remaining true, during his entire 60 year career, to the style established by Riza ʿAbbasi at the beginning of the 17th century. Therefore, Europeanising motifs are very rare in his oeuvre. However, in this piece he not only integrated a set piece probably stemming from European portraits and prints - the symmetrically divided and high-bound curtain - but also an old woman peering in through the door. The theme of the uninvited observer was to enjoy great popularity in Iran, especially in the 19th century, making it one of the earliest representations of this specific iconography.
materials: Watercolour and gold on paper (miniature); opaque watercolour and gold on paper (border)
tags: opaque watercolour and gold on paper (border)

en.name: *Harem*
short_description: Pascal Sébah (1823–1886) was a French photographer working in the Ottoman Empire. This photo of a harem is interesting insofar as it  differs from the mainstream representations of harems in the Western imagination, which were influenced by the painter Gérôme. Indeed, many local customs - both real and imagined - captured the interest of European artists, and their Orientalist art then fuelled both the Western fascination with and revulsion towards the East.
keywords: Orientalism; harem

fr.name: *Harem*
short_description: Pascal Sébah (1823-1886), photographe français, a travaillé dans l’Empire ottoman. La photographie de harem proposée ici est intéressante. Elle tranche avec les représentations plus habituelles d’un harem fantasmé par les Occidentaux, influencé en particulier par les tableaux du peintre Gérôme. En effet, certaines coutumes orientales, réelles ou supposées, ont depuis le XVIIe siècle excité la curiosité des artistes et ces représentations ont à leur tour nourri l’imaginaire de l’Occident entre fascination et répulsion.
keywords: Orientalisme; harem

ar.name: صندوق من النحاس الأصفر.
description:
صندوق أسطواني من النحاس الأصفر ذو غطاء بمفصّلة مطعّم بزخارف من الفضة. على الحافة الدائرية للغطاء تصميمات على شكل ضفائر حول الحافة، وأربع بطات توت رقابها إلى الخلف لتشكل عقدة في المركز. وتزين جسم الصندوق سلسلة من الرصائع رباعية الفصوص تتناوب مع تشكيلات من الأرابيسك والزخارف التصويرية تحيط بها أشكال هندسية. وثمة نقش بالعربية على حافة الغطاء تقول: عز لمولانا أتابك الملك الرحيم العالم العادل المؤيد المظفر المنصور المجاهد المرابط بدر الدنيا والدين لؤلؤ حسام أمير المؤمنين.  
عين بدر الدين أتابكاً (التي تعني بالتركية "السيد الأب") لثلاثة من الأمراء الزنكيين من عام615- 31/ 1218- 33. كان الأتابكة في البداية حماة أو معلمين لأمراء السلالة السلجوقية، وقد ازدادت قوتهم في الوقت الذي ضعفت فيه سلطة السلاجقة. وفي عام 631/1233 أصبح بدر الدين لؤلؤ حاكماً مستقلاً واتخذ لنفسه لقب الملك "الملك الرحيم" بعد أن حصل على تقليد رسمي بذلك من الخليفة العباسي المستنصر. وكان بدر الدين لؤلؤ راعياً نشطاً للصناعات المعدنية؛ حيث تحمل اسمه خمس قطع معدنية مطعمة لا زالت موجودة حتى الآن. رغم أن تقنية التطعيم قد استلهمت من الشرق، غير أن الأنماط الزخرفية وأشكال الأواني كانت مستقاة من نماذج محلية.

تميَّزت الموصل بصناعاتها المعدنية، في القرن السابع الهجري/ الثالث عشر الميلادي. القطعة عبارة عن صندوق نحاسي، تمَّ تطعيمه بالفضة، وأهم ما يميّزه هو النقش الموجود عليه، والذي يظهر فيه اسم حاكم الموصل "بدر الدين لولو"، والذي اعتُبر من أهم المهتمين بالصناعات المعدنية، في تلك الفترة.
keywords: زخرفة تصويرية؛ زخرفة هندسية؛ العصر الزنكي.

en.name: Brass box.
description: A cylindrical brass box with a hinged lid, inlaid with silver decoration. The lid has a plait design around the edge and four ducks with their necks bent backwards in a knot pattern in the centre. A series of quatrefoil medallions with alternating arabesques and figures, surrounded by a geometric pattern, decorate the body of the box. An Arabic inscription around the lid reads: 'Glory to our master, the clement King, all wise, just, aided by God, victorious, having the support of the Deity, who combats infidels, who practices devotion, Badr al-din Lu'lu', the sword of the commander of the faithful'. Badr al-Din Lu'lu' was appointed Atabeg (Turkish 'father-lord') for three Zangid princes from AH 615–31 / AD 1218–33. Atabegs, initially guardians or tutors for princes of the Seljuq dynasty, grew more powerful while the authority of the Seljuqs waned. In AH 631 / AD 1233 Badr al-Din Lu'lu' became an independent ruler and took sovereign title of Malik al-Rahim after obtaining an investiture from the Abbasid Caliph, al-Mustansir. Badr al-Din Lu'lu' was an active patron of the metalwork industry; no fewer than five extant inlaid metal objects bear his name. Although the inlaid technique was borrowed from the East, the decorative motifs and vessel forms were from local models.

Mosul was renowned for its metalwork industry in the early AH 7th / AD 13th century. This brass box, inlaid with silver, is particularly interesting as it is inscribed with the name Badr al-din Lu’lu’, who was ruler of Mosul and a keen patron of inlaid metalwork.
keywords: Geometric decoration; figurative decoration; figurative representation; Zangids; inlay; inscription; calligraphy, geometric pattern; geometric decoration; engraving; arabesque

es.name: Caja de latón.
description:
Pequeña caja de latón cilíndrica con tapa unida al cuerpo por bisagras. Está decorada con incrustaciones de plata. La tapa presenta un trenzado en el borde y, en el centro, un motivo en nudo de cuatro patos con el cuello hacia atrás. El cuerpo está decorado con medallones cuadrifolios en que alternan arabescos y figuras rodeados de dibujos geométricos. La inscripción circular de la tapa reza: “Gloria a nuestro maestro, el rey clemente, lleno de sabiduría, justo, ayudado por Dios, victorioso, que tiene el sostén de la deidad, quien combate a los infieles, quien practica la devoción, Badr al-Din Lulu, la espada del comandante de los fieles”.  
Entre 615 y 631 / 1218-1233, Badr al-Din Lulu fue nombrado atabeg (en turco, 'padre-señor') de tres príncipes zangíes. Los atabegs eran en un principio guardianes o tutores de príncipes de la dinastía selyuqí, pero fueron volviéndose cada vez más poderosos, al tiempo que decaía la autoridad selyuqí. En 631 /1233, Badr al-Din Lulu se convirtió en gobernante independiente y, tras ser investido por el califa abbasí al-Mustansir, adopta el título soberano de Malik al-Rahim. Badr al-Din Lulu fue un importante mecenas de la artesanía del metal, de la que se conservan al menos cinco objetos con su nombre. Aunque la técnica de la incrustación se tomó del Lejano oriente, los motivos decorativos y la forma de esta pieza son de inspiración local.

A principios del siglo VII / XIII, Mosul era célebre por su metalistería. Esta caja de latón con incrustaciones de plata es particularmente interesante por tener inscrito el nombre de Badr al-Din Lulu, gobernante de la ciudad y mecenas de obras de metal con incrustaciones.
keywords: decoración geométrica; decoración figurativa

fr.name: Boîte en cuivre jaune.
description:
Boîte cylindrique en cuivre jaune fermée par un couvercle à charnière et incrustée d'un décor d'argent. Le couvercle est orné sur sa retombée d'un motif tressé et, au centre, de quatre canards dont le cou renversé forme un nœud. Une série de médaillons quadrilobés, meublés en alternance par des arabesques et des figures et entourés d'un motif géométrique, orne le corps de la boîte. Une inscription autour du couvercle dit : “Gloire à notre maître, le roi clément, celui qui est à la fois sage, juste, aidé de Dieu, victorieux, ayant le soutien de la Divinité, qui combat les infidèles, qui pratique la dévotion, Badr al-din Lulu, épée du commandeur des fidèles.”  
Badr al-din Lulu fut nommé atabeg (“père-seigneur” en turc) auprès de trois princes zenguides de 615 à 631 H / 1218-1233 J.-C. Les atabegs, initialement gardiens ou tuteurs de princes de la dynastie seldjoukide, devinrent de plus en plus puissants au fur et à mesure que l'autorité des Seldjoukides s'affaiblissait. En 631 H / 1233 J.-C., Badr al-din Lulu devint souverain indépendant et prit le nom de Malik al-Rahmin après avoir obtenu l'investiture du calife abbasside al-Mustansir. Il fut un important commanditaire de l'industrie du métal. Pas moins de cinq objets en métal incrusté portant son nom sont parvenus jusqu'à nous. Si la technique d'incrustation venait de l'Est, les motifs décoratifs et les formes étaient issus de modèles locaux.

Mossoul était réputée pour son travail du métal au début du VIIe s. H / XIIIe s. J.-C. Cette boîte en cuivre jaune à incrustations d'argent est particulièrement intéressante en ce qu'on y trouve une inscription au nom de Badr al-Din Lulu, souverain de Mossoul et généreux commanditaire d'objets en métal incrusté.
keywords: Décoration géométrique ; décoration figurative
materials: Cuivre jaune gravé et incrusté d’argent.
tags: Cuivre jaune gravé et incrusté d’argent.

en.name: God
description: In his practice, Haji Noor Deen employs, develops and further interprets Sini calligraphy. The Sini style, which emerged in the 14th century AD, fuses Chinese and Arabic calligraphic traditions. Born in 1963 in Shangdong province, China, Haji Noor Deen graduated from Egypt Sadat Calligraphy School and obtained his calligraphy *ijaza* in Istanbul. This work is made of patterned light blue-gold silk with mounted calligraphy on paper. The central calligraphy in black ink depicts the word "God" in both Chinese and Arabic letters in thick, opaque brush strokes. The title of the work appears in black ink on the left, above two red seals. A third red seal appears on the top right.
materials: Ink and red seal colour on rice paper, mounted on silk
tags: Ink and red seal colour on rice paper, mounted on silk
partner: Museum of Islamic Art at the Pergamon Museum, State Museums

en.name: *The Recapture of Buda in 1686*
description:
In 1686, two years after the unsuccessful siege of Buda, a renewed campaign began to enter the Hungarian capital. This time, the Holy League's army was twice as large with over 74,000 men, including German, Hungarian, Croatian, Dutch, English, Spanish, Czech, Italian, French, Burgundian, Danish and Swedish soldiers, along with other Europeans as volunteers, artillerymen, and officers.  
By the middle of June 1686, the siege had begun. A Turkish relief army arrived at Buda in the middle of August, but Abdurrahman Abdi Paşa shrank from the large-scale attack against the siege army, and on 2 September 1686 came upon the resisting *Generalsturm* (General's Tower) at the fortress. The commanders in chief were Charles Duke V of Lorraine (1643–1690) and Maximilan II Emanuel Elector of Bavaria (1679–1726).  Prince Eugene of Savoy and his dragoons were not directly involved in entering the city, but secured the rear of their army against the Turkish relief army, which could not prevent the city from being entered after 145 years in Turkish possession.  
This engraving by Romeyn de Hooghe represents the great explosion of 22 July 1686, the dramatic and decisive event of the attack, showing a partly fictitious topography of the city. The commanders in chief with their army are represented in the foreground Pest-side, while besides them in Pest and in Buda, are their camps and attacking battle corps, with the city of Buda on fire and in ruins, and Gellért Hill on the far left.  
The print was published with German and Dutch inscriptions. The following is from the Dutch inscription seen at the top: “Belegering der sterke stad, Buda of Offen, door de keyserlyke en geallierde machten. 1686.” (The siege of the strong city of Buda – aka Offen – by the allied, imperial forces. 1686.) The print is signed in the middle at the bottom: “R. de Hooge jnv: et fecit. 1686.”

This print by Romeyn de Hooghe is the most famous of numerous representations of the recapture of Buda in 1686. It depicts a topographical, partly exact bird’s eye view, with a Baroque battle scene complete with representations of the commanders in chief in the foreground, and the castle and city of Buda on fire, in the background.
keywords: Battle scene; Holy League; Turks; Turkish Wars; Ottoman; Ottoman army; Charles Duke V of Lorraine; Maximilian II Emanuel Elector of Bavaria; Prince Eugene of Savoy; Abdurrahman Abdi Paşa, Buda; warfare; inscription
tags: Maximilian II Emanuel Elector of Bavaria

de.name: Deckenfresko: *Die Verherrlichung des hl. Karl Borromäus*
description: Die Fresken in Volders zählen zu den bedeutendsten Leistungen Knollers. Die Apotheose des Kirchenpatrons in der Hauptkuppel ist der Höhepunkt des Bildprogramms, der von Szenen aus dem Leben des Heiligen umgeben ist. Als bedeutender Vertreter der Gegenreformation geht mit seiner Verherrlichung der Triumph des katholischen Glaubens einher. Knollers klare Komposition stellt das Geschehen in monumentalen Figuren dar, seine bei aller Pracht akademische Disziplin trägt bereits Züge des Klassizismus.

en.name: Ceiling fresco: *The Veneration of St. Charles Borromeo*
description: The frescos in Volders are among the most important of Knoller’s works. The apotheosis of the church patron in the main cupola is the high point of the programme, surrounded by scenes from his life. As an important representative of the Counter Reformation his veneration goes hand in hand with the victory of Catholicism. Knoller’s clear composition with monumental figures already contains elements of Classicism.
place: Main cupola, The Servite Monastery Church of St. Charles Borromeo

en.name: Kharoi
description: Used by fishermen to store their fish, this indigenous pot is made using local materials such as bamboo and jute. Whilst its principal purpose is to allow water to drain through to keep the fish intact, it is also used by farmers to carry their tools or crops.
keywords: Water; kharoi; basket

en.name: *Azulejos* depicting the 14 Acts of Mercy
description: *Azulejos* representing the 14 Acts of Mercy cover the walls of the nave. On the Gospel side are the Spiritual Works and on the Epistle side the Corporal. In the central arch, a large *azulejos* panel depicts Our Lady of Mercy, who with her open veil, appears as if protecting the visitors.
